mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair raloxifene efficacy and increase adverse effects through altered renal clearance and metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and bone markers closely; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy; consider alternative antifungal if possible; supplement potassium and magnesium as needed.
